name: opencode-suite
body: The `opencode-suite/` distribution — the `apg_*` tools and the shared `lib/apg.ts` plumbing, embedded into the apg binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/`. It is the consumer boundary of the graph: its curated tools read the scanned graph and return results to agents and editors, and it is where a stored repo-relative identity is resolved to an absolute path against the caller's project directory. This change-set is ordinary release work shipping with the next release; the already-installed copies (a project's `.opencode/` and the cross-project `~/.opencode/`, from the fixed 0.14.1 tooling) are not changed by it.
